messages:
sam_w: Noticed a flaky ordering issue during a resume scenario with node sample-app v0.10.7. Customer sees older chunk part arrive after newer seqs, causing word jumble in final output.

sam_w: Repro (intermittent): start stream -> force short auth refresh (client drops ~150ms) -> reconnect with resume token -> resume replay mixes with newly emitted fragments.

liz_k: Can you paste the wire-level SSE snippet? Need to confirm event boundaries and ids.

sam_w: Wire capture (trimmed):
```
: ping
event: message
id:890 data:{"seq":890,"part":1,"text":"Inter"}

: ping
connection: reset

event: message
id:891 data:{"seq":891,"part":1,"text":"nal "}
event: message
id:890 data:{"seq":890,"part":2,"text":"face"}
```

sam_w: Client rendering ended up as: "Inter nal face" (space misplaced).

runtime-bot: FYI a recent proxy perf tweak allowed async tail-flush on disconnect (to reduce p99 latency). That can allow buffered fragments to be sent out-of-order relative to resumed replay.

sdk-erin: Short-term SDK mitigation: buffer incoming fragments by (seq,part) and hold emission for a small rescue window on resume (e.g., 100ms) or until all parts seen. I'll open a tiny PR to add that to sample-app and the official node SDK.

qa_jin: Add an integration test with a deterministic flappy-proxy that reorders delivery, so we don't regress. Make the timeout configurable for mobile vs server SDKs.

liz_k: Long-term: runtime should expose explicit ordering headers (X-Chunk-Seq, X-Chunk-Part) and have an option to drain outgoing buffer before starting resume replay. That way clients can reorder deterministically instead of parsing body JSON.

sam_w: Agreed. Also add Last-Event-ID compatibility note for browsers; some consumers rely on that instead of resume_token.

sdk-erin: PR: https://git.internal/r/node-sdk/512 (adds buffer-on-resume + flaky integration harness). Tests simulate tcp close + reordered replay.

runtime-bot: Created ticket PROXY-2199 to evaluate drain-before-resume and add X-Chunk-Seq header. Priority P2.

sam_w: Deploying SDK canary to repro env now. Will report back once we confirm ordering fixes. If canary passes, we should ship the SDK patch and schedule the runtime change behind a feature flag. :thumbsup:

liz_k: Also please add a short doc in docs/streaming-reconnects.md that explains resume semantics, recommended client behavior (buffering, timeouts), and how Last-Event-ID vs resume_token interact. Saves future debugging time.

qa_jin: On it — will vet the flaky test and canary results once ci finishes.
